column1: # hub-vocabulary.tsv (harbor#1278) — the closed values a member laptop may send to the board.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The board is one repo every member can read, so a request or event holds only these values, digests,
# numbers and kebab ids. bin/hub-format.sh refuses anything else, and an event with a free-text field fails its test.
